contracts.input_semantics: Finite observed level/time, non-empty controller identity, non-negative epoch, and local reference HMAC key.
contracts.output_semantics: Returns an immutable HMAC-SHA-256 tagged simulation transfer binding controller, epoch, observation, and time.
contracts.error_semantics: Malformed controller, epoch, level, or observation time raises ValueError.
contracts.unknown_semantics: A transfer is a local simulation artifact and grants no authority or physical command permission.
contracts.effect_semantics: Creates no physical effect; produces an in-memory reference-model transfer.
postconditions: tag binds controller, epoch, observation and time

contracts.input_semantics: Transfer record and current local reference assumptions.
contracts.output_semantics: Returns true only for finite, structurally valid HMAC-matching fields using constant-time comparison.
contracts.error_semantics: Malformed transfer returns false; malformed assumptions are rejected at construction.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Authentication failure is fail-closed and cannot establish current authority.
contracts.effect_semantics: Performs no effect; evaluates a local simulation token only.

contracts.input_semantics: Finite bounded command, active controller identity, and current fencing epoch.
contracts.output_semantics: Accepts only the current active controller at the current epoch; stale or malformed commands are recorded as rejected.
contracts.error_semantics: Invalid commands return false and are retained in rejected-command evidence.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Acceptance is reference-model admission, not physical actuation or external authority.
contracts.effect_semantics: Changes no external target; later Euler integration uses the admitted reference command.
postconditions: stale primary command fenced after fallback

contracts.input_semantics: Finite non-negative duration within max_duration_s and fully bounded configuration.
contracts.output_semantics: Produces trajectory with final-horizon sample and explicit assurance loss for bounded fault injections.
contracts.error_semantics: Invalid duration raises ValueError; bounded faults enter assurance-loss minimum-risk mode.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Finite Euler samples do not prove continuous-time safety, hardware behavior, or fallback independence.
contracts.effect_semantics: In-memory reference simulation only; no hardware, network, or physical actuator effect.

contracts.input_semantics: Fallback state, finite dwell, explicit fixture revalidation/fresh-authorization, and current recoverable observation.
contracts.output_semantics: Returns true and advances epoch only when all local reference conditions hold; otherwise records blocked return.
contracts.error_semantics: Non-finite dwell raises ValueError; invalid or stale return state is blocked.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Boolean attestations are fixtures, not evidence of real authority or root-cause closure.
contracts.effect_semantics: Changes reference-model controller/epoch only; no production controller transition.

contracts.input_semantics: Two agent identities, epochs, and proposed commands for one simulated actuator.
contracts.output_semantics: Rejects differing epoch or command proposals as conflicting shared-actuator commands.
contracts.error_semantics: Conflict returns a typed rejection rather than selecting an arbitrary agent.
contracts.unknown_semantics: Identical local commands do not prove multi-agent coordination or external authorization.
contracts.effect_semantics: Produces only a reference decision; does not allocate an external resource.
preconditions: two declared simulation proposals plus explicit trusted coordination fixture
postconditions: untrusted equality and conflicting commands are blocked

limitations: Declarations are reference-only and semantic_compliance_proved remains false.
Unbound public functions are reported as FRONTIER by the coverage audit.
This registry neither changes the current canonical registry nor authorizes physical actuation or certification.
